report.answer_text:
Bitcoin's 2025 all-time high was about $126,000, reached on October 6, 2025. Coinbase puts it at $126,210.50 on that date.[1] Other data providers differ slightly. Investing News Network reports $126,198.07 that day, before a close of $124,752.53.[2] Providers typically record peaks between about $126,100 and $126,300, depending on which exchanges they average.[3]
Bitcoin set several records on the way up in 2025:
January 20: about $109,356, around Trump's inauguration.[4]
May 22: $111,970.[4]
July 14: about $123,400.[4]
August 14: about $124,291.[4]
The peak didn't last. On October 10, 2025, a sudden sell-off triggered roughly $19 billion of liquidations in leveraged crypto positions, the largest single-day wipe-out on record.[3] As of the latest data in that source, BTC trades at $73,382, about 41.9% below the record.[5] That figure is from November 12, 2026. A different source shows a lower price, so check a live tracker for the current number.
